_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hyperelasticity#7, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: MeshQuad.to_simplex() was renamed to .to_meshtri(); the legacy call raises AttributeError "'MeshQuad1' object has no attribute 'to_simplex'" and hasattr(...,'to_simplex') is False. Ran: MeshQuad.init_tensor on a 5x5 tensor grid (16 quads, 25 vertices), both hasattr probes, the legacy call, the modern call, and a Poisson stiffness assembly on both meshes. Printed: hasattr_to_meshtri=True, hasattr_to_simplex=False, the AttributeError message verbatim naming the CONCRETE class MeshQuad1; to_meshtri returns a MeshTri1 with 32 elements (exactly 2x the 16 quads) on the same 25 vertices; the triangulated stiffness matrix is the same 25x25 shape but SPARSER (105 non-zeros vs 169) because the split drops the quad's diagonal couplings, which is a structural fingerprint that the connectivity really changed.
